entries.zh:
毒品活动侵扰周边社区，居民盼恢复安宁

近来，周边地区接连出现与毒品有关的治安问题。原本安静的街巷中，夜间争吵、陌生人员频繁出入等情况逐渐增多，一些居民开始提前关门，商铺也缩短了营业时间。

对不少家庭而言，变化并不是从一次严重事件开始的。有人起初只是经常晚归，随后失去工作、向亲友借钱，最终连家中的日常开支也难以维持。家属往往在问题已经难以掩盖时，才意识到发生了什么。

一名不愿透露姓名的居民说，过去孩子们放学后会在附近玩到天黑，如今家长总会反复叮嘱他们早点回家。比起新闻里的案件，人们更直接感受到的，是生活中越来越多的不安。

目前，警方正对相关线索展开调查。部分问题并非局限于某一处场所，涉案人员之间的联系仍有待查明。居民希望，调查能够尽快取得进展，让街道重新恢复往日的安宁。

……报道下方已经破损，后续内容无法辨认。
entries.en:
Drug Activity Disrupts Local Communities; Residents Hope for Peace

Recently, neighborhoods in the surrounding area have seen a series of drug-related disturbances. Once-quiet streets now face more nighttime arguments and frequent visits from unfamiliar people. Some residents have begun closing their doors early, and shops have shortened their opening hours.

For many families, the change did not begin with one major incident. Someone might first return home late more often, then lose their job and borrow from friends and relatives, until even everyday household costs became impossible to meet. Family members often only understood what had happened when the problem could no longer be hidden.

One resident, who asked to remain anonymous, said children used to play nearby after school until dark. Now parents repeatedly remind them to come home early. More than the cases in the news, people feel a growing unease in their daily lives.

Police are currently investigating the available leads. The problems may not be confined to a single location, and the connections between those involved have yet to be established. Residents hope the investigation will make progress soon and restore the streets to their former peace.

...The bottom of the report is torn. The remaining text cannot be read.

entries.en: Then when will you tell me your name?

entries.zh: 那你现在知道发生什么事了吗？
entries.en: Do you know what happened now?

entries.zh: 那可不一定。对了，昨天你怎么被他们关在体育器材室了？
entries.en: I wouldn't be so sure. Anyway, how did they lock you in the equipment room yesterday?

entries.zh: 那就告诉我，发生了什么。
那我下次设置密码把你的名字也加上。
entries.en: Next time I'll put your name in it too.

entries.zh: 邻居说赵今瑞可能去接补习班的孩子了。
entries.en: A neighbor says Zhao Jinrui may have gone to pick up children from tutoring class.

entries.zh: 郑涛昨天就被锁在这了，还以为我找他有事，带了一只铅笔下来，结果被关里面了。
entries.en: They locked Zheng Tao in here yesterday. He thought I wanted to see him, so he came down with a pencil. Then they locked him in.

entries.zh: 郑涛昨天就被锁在这了，还以为我找他有事，带了一只铅笔下来，结果被关里面了，看来待会得把我社交平台的密码改了。
entries.en: They locked Zheng Tao in here yesterday. He thought I wanted to see him, so he came down with a pencil. Then they locked him in. Looks like I need to change my social account password later.
Zheng Tao is still by his seat.

entries.zh: 郑涛这家伙真是个麻烦事。
entries.en: That Zheng Tao is such a pain.

entries.zh: 里面还有一张工作证……边角已经被雨水泡软了。
entries.en: There's a work ID inside too... Its corners are soft from the rain.

entries.zh: 里面都是老师和领导，没有事情还是最好不要进去了
entries.en: It is full of teachers and school administrators. Best not to go in without a reason.

entries.zh: 钓点鱼，拿到隔壁镇集市卖，补贴家用。
entries.en: Catching a few fish to sell at the next town's market. A little extra for the family.
There must be a key somewhere nearby.
The lock is old, but it is still holding.
Hold Space to try to see clearly

entries.zh: 门前靠着钓鱼竿，旁边放着水桶。
entries.en: A fishing rod leans beside the door, with a bucket nearby.

entries.zh: 随你怎么说，让我刻完先。
entries.en: Say what you like. Let me finish carving first.
Take some pictures and have fun.

entries.zh:
露天电影放映通知
7月16日晚7:30，镇文化站门前夏季露天电影，居民自带板凳，小朋友由家长陪同。
——镇文化站
entries.en:
Outdoor Movie Screening
A summer outdoor film will be shown outside the cultural center at 7:30 p.m. on July 16. Bring your own stool. Children should be accompanied by a parent.
- Town Cultural Center

entries.zh: 骑士翻查账本，又找来车夫。原来粮食按老国王的命令，送往城外受灾的村庄。
entries.en: The knight searched the ledgers and found the wagon driver. The grain had been sent, on the old king's orders, to villages outside the city struck by disaster.

entries.zh: 高三一班独立内部；双门保留
entries.en: Separate Class 3-1 interior; both doors retained

entries.zh: 高三二班独立内部；两版本同四桌位置
entries.en: Separate Class 3-2 interior; matching four-desk positions in both versions
(This section of the preview ends here.)

aliases.source: An old key found beneath a newspaper fragment.
aliases.zh: 在报纸碎片下面找到的一把旧钥匙。

aliases.source: A torn piece of an old newspaper.
aliases.zh: 从旧报纸上撕下的一块碎片。

aliases.source: Somewhere you've always wanted to come back to.
aliases.zh: 一个你一直想回来的地方。

aliases.source: Then why does everything around me feel so unfamiliar?
aliases.zh: 那为什么周围的一切都这么陌生？

aliases.source: Looks like you really don't remember anything.
aliases.zh: 看来你真的什么都不记得了。
那就告诉我，发生了什么。

aliases.source: Go through that gate. You'll find what you forgot.
aliases.zh: 穿过那扇铁门，你会找到遗忘的东西。

aliases.source: No one seems to notice me.
There are too many people gathered here.
...I don't want to look at it for too long.
The lights are off, but it looks like it has been here for a while.
aliases.zh: 车灯熄着，看起来已经停了有一会儿。

aliases.source: Why would the police be here?
Why is there blood on my face?
aliases.zh: 我的脸上为什么会有血？
我的倒影……看起来很正常。

aliases.source: For a second, I thought someone was standing behind me.
aliases.zh: 刚才有一瞬间，我还以为身后站着一个人。
一块撕下来的报纸碎片……

aliases.source: Most of the article is missing.
aliases.zh: 报道的大部分内容都缺失了。

aliases.source: It looks old enough to belong to that gate.
aliases.zh: 它看起来很旧，也许就是那扇铁门的钥匙。

aliases.source: The lock is old, but it is still holding.
There must be a key somewhere nearby.
So we beat on, boats against the current,
aliases.zh: 于是我们继续向前，逆流而行，

aliases.source: borne back ceaselessly into the past.
F. Scott Fitzgerald — The Great Gatsby
